en: The Chapter on Similes, Section on Ants.
4. The Question on the Scorpion’s Limb “Venerable Nāgasena, when you say that ‘one limb of the scorpion should be taken,’ which is that one limb that should be taken?
“Just as, Great King, the scorpion, whose weapon is its tail, moves about raising its tail;”
In the same way, great king, a practitioner of yoga, a follower of the spiritual life, should possess the weapon of knowledge and should dwell having raised up that knowledge.
This, great king, is one quality to be taken from the scorpion.
And this was said, great king, by the Elder Upasena, the son of Vaṅganta:
Having grasped the sword of knowledge and dwelling as one possessing insight,
one is liberated from all fear.
"And he would be difficult to overcome.
This is the fourth question on the limbs of a scorpion.
